clips.title: The story
paras: In the years since the Third War, Heartswood draws warlocks toward an old night elf tragedy. Takar the Seer sends them into Ashenvale for Gakin the Darkbinder, who needs the wood to lure and subjugate a succubus in Stormwind.

Takar the Seer says Heartswood grew where the night elf lovers Anathera and Latherion fell during the War of the Ancients ten thousand years ago. Their last breaths and devotion nourished the tree. To mortal eyes, it marks a tragic love; to practitioners of the dark arts, its concentrated emotion is potent magical fuel.

Succubi feed on mortal passion, desire, and torment. Takar knows ordinary temptations cannot match an artifact filled with thousands of years of devotion. A piece of Heartswood gives Gakin the Darkbinder the catalyst he needs to draw a cunning demon through the Nether and into a summoning circle in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In preparation for your coming, I used my sight to look over the world and through the mists of time. I have found what it is you seek.
In the War of the Ancients, two lovers fell together in battle. Where they took their last breaths, a tree known as the heartswood grew, a symbol of their undying love.
That should be enough to tempt a succubus. You will find it in the ruins of Ordil'Aran in the northwestern part of the forest of Ashenvale.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Was your search a success, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I can tell this will do nicely, let me just work with it for a moment...
Takar is a resourceful fellow to have around, isn't he? If only I could persuade him to move back to civilization.
